## Purpose

This crate implements triage for incoming blockchain events through multi-stage Bayesian and anomaly-detection pipelines. It produces curiosity scores and routing decisions that feed into the Adaptive Gate for T0/T1/T2 cognitive-tier selection. Triage is the critical bridge between raw chain intelligence (from `golem-chain-intelligence`) and the Golem's actual decision-making.

## Key Invariants

- Gas tier thermometer encoding must assign each gas value to exactly one of five non-overlapping tiers: minimal < 30K, low 30K–100K, medium 100K–300K, high 300K–1M, extreme > 1M
- Value bucket assignment (dust < 0.01 ETH, small 0.01–1 ETH, medium 1–10 ETH, large 10–100 ETH, whale > 100 ETH) must be deterministic and non-overlapping for all f64 values
- HDC transaction encoding must be deterministic: same `NormalizedTx` always produces identical `HdcVector` (Hamming distance = 0)
- Selector-only changes produce near-orthogonal vectors (Hamming distance 0.45–0.55 in 10,240-bit space)
- HDC encoding latency must stay under 10 microseconds per transaction
- Curiosity scores must monotonically decrease as episode_count increases (cold-start factor anneals over time)

## Public API

`TriageEngine` — Entry point; owns all four stages + curiosity scorer  
`TriagedEvent` — Event + fingerprint + curiosity score + anomaly + tier  
`TriageConfig` — Max queue depth, tier thresholds, anomaly boost flags  
`TriageContext` — Per-event accumulator passed through pipeline stages  
`TriageStage` — `async fn process(&self, ctx: &mut TriageContext) -> Option<()>` trait  
`CuriosityScorer` — Hedge-weighted 5-signal compositor  
`CuriosityScore` — f32 score + nn_distance + novelty_reason + tier_suggestion  
`NoveltyReason` — Routine | MagnitudeDeviation | PatternDeviation | TimingAnomaly | HighImpactEvent | UnseenProtocolCombination  
`HdcTxEncoder` — Encodes `NormalizedTx` into 10,240-bit BSC vector via role-filler binding  
`TxCodebook` — Maps named concepts to canonical `HdcVector` entries  
`DecodedTxFields` — protocol, selector, gas_tier, value_bucket, clusters, topics, tokens  
`BayesianSurprise` — Per-protocol conjugate models; returns KL divergence  
`ProtocolBelief` — GammaPoisson event_rate + NormalInverseGamma value_dist  
`CuriosityAnnIndex` — Two-tier HNSW (main + staging) over 80-dim fingerprints  
`ThompsonRouter` — Beta posteriors per routing bucket  
`RoutingDecision` — Escalate | Emit | Silent | Discard  
`MidasR` — Streaming graph anomaly detector  
`Bocpd` — Bayesian online changepoint detection  
`RegimeDetector` — Per-metric BOCPD instances  
`Adwin` — Adaptive windowing with Hoeffding bounds  
`ChangePointResult` — changepoint_probability + map_run_length + is_changepoint  
`CountMinSketch` — Conservative-update CMS for frequency estimation  
`SlidingFrequencySketch` — Two-CMS sliding window for spike detection  
`StageScores` — Per-stage partial scores  
`TxCategory` — ProtocolInteraction | TokenTransfer | LargeValueMove | MevActivity | ContractDeploy | Unknown  
`ProtocolViewSchema` — Declarative TUI view description  
`ProtocolFamily` — UniswapV2Pool | UniswapV3Pool | AaveV3Market | CompoundMarket | CurvePool | ERC4626Vault | DEX_GENERIC | LENDING_GENERIC | UNKNOWN  
`ViewGenerator` — classify_protocol() + generate_template_schema()  
`TriageStore` — redb persistence layer for events, scores, negative fingerprints

## Dependencies

- `golem-core` — `HdcVector`, `CorticalState`, `EventFabric`, `CognitiveTier` for state and event abstractions
- `golem-chain-intelligence` — `ChainEvent`, `NormalizedTx`, `BlockMetadata`, `ChainScope`, `ProtocolState`, `ProtocolRegistry` for incoming data types

## Implementation Notes

- Modules: `fingerprint`, `scorer`, `surprise`, `ann`, `thompson`, `anomaly`, `sketch`, `views`, `store`, `stage`, `engine`
- `HdcTxEncoder` uses deterministic role-filler binding; selector changes must produce ~0.5 Hamming distance for orthogonality
- Thermometer encoding is cumulative: adjacent tiers share bundles, producing partial similarity in fingerprint space (adjacent Hamming distance < non-adjacent distance)
- `CuriosityScorer` weights five signals with hedge ratios and anneals cold-start factor over episodes; all signals feed into final f32 score
- Stage trait accepts mutable `TriageContext` and returns `Option<()>` to allow early exit on decision
- `BayesianSurprise` runs conjugate updates on per-protocol belief models: Gamma-Poisson for event rate, NIG for value distribution
- `Bocpd` and `Adwin` run independent changepoint/drift detection; alerts feed regime severity into curiosity multiplier
- `MidasR` is streaming graph anomaly detection (Count-Min Sketch for edge frequency, chi-squared against baseline)
- `TriageStore` uses redb for persistence of fingerprints, scores, and negative samples for offline learning and replay
- `ProtocolViewSchema` is serializable JSON; `ViewGenerator` infers display schema from protocol ABI and cached protocol family

## Test Requirements

- `test_gas_tier_ranges_exhaustive_nonoverlapping` — proptest: all u64 gas values map to exactly one tier
- `test_value_bucket_ranges_exhaustive_nonoverlapping` — proptest: all f64 ETH values map to exactly one bucket
- `test_fingerprint_same_tx_deterministic` — unit: re-encoding same `NormalizedTx` produces zero Hamming distance
- `test_fingerprint_different_selector_orthogonal` — unit: selector-only change produces 0.45–0.55 Hamming distance
- `test_gas_tier_thermometer_adjacent_similar` — unit: adjacent tiers closer than non-adjacent
- `test_encode_cost_under_10us` — unit: encode latency mean < 10µs, p99 < 15µs
- `test_cold_start_blend_monotonicity` — unit: cold_start_factor decreases monotonically with episode_count
Integration tests in `tests/integration/` covering multi-stage pipeline with mocked `ChainEvent` inputs and assertions on output `TriagedEvent` fields.

## Do Not

- Do not skip determinism checks; HDC encoding must be reproducible or fingerprint-based deduplication breaks the cascade
- Do not conflate thermometer bundle adjacency with closeness in value space; adjacent tiers are Hamming-similar only because they accumulate bundles, not because ranges overlap
- Do not block on external LLM calls in `ThompsonRouter`; routing must return within the stage latency budget
- Do not add anomaly detectors without integrating them into `StageScores` and verifying they improve the hedge-weighted curiosity compositor
